blocks.body:
name = "acme/stages"
version = "1.0.0"
[stages.a]
unlock = "at_start"

[stages.b]
unlock = "at_start"

[stages.c]
submit = "x"

[stages.d]
unlock = "whenever"

[stages.e]
unlock = "after:a"
ready = { interval = "x" }

[stages.e.agent]
timeout = 5

[stages.e.verifier]
feedback = "rationales"
snapshot = [{ run = "x" }]

diagnostics.message: [stages.e.verifier] feedback = "rationales" is cut: a trainable seat may be shown its verdicts, levels, and scores, never a judge's rationales. Write feedback = "verdicts" or "none"
[stages.d] unlock must be on_submit, on_request, at_start, after:<stage>, or at_turn:<n>

[stages.e.verifier] snapshot[0] needs reads, the absolute paths whose state the command reads: the runtime puts each on a volume when the sandbox starts, and the snapshot runs in a fresh container that sees only those paths. Harbor's collect has no such key, so an imported entry needs them added
only one stage can unlock at_start: its prompt is the instruction
stage a unlocks at_start, so its prompt is the instruction; remove its ```stage a block
[stages.c] needs unlock, when its prompt is revealed: on_submit, on_request, at_start, after:<stage>, or at_turn:<n>
[stages.e.agent] timeout must be a duration such as "90s", "15m", or "1h30m"
[stages.e] ready needs run, the command that must pass
[stages.e] ready interval must be a duration such as "5s" or "1m"
